design: DTI_v1 (5 seeds, non-deterministic) is the pilot. DTI_v2 (10 seeds, --deterministic) is the confirmatory run; the hypotheses below are derived from the pilot and fixed before DTI_v2 is looked at.

rationale.comp_primary: The three pieces of the loss and of negative sampling that the pipeline inherits from PathogenKG or that shape the decision boundary: number of training negatives, focal loss, adversarial weighting. Each was lower in the pilot (-0.163, -0.033, -0.028 MRR).
rationale.comp_secondary: comp_no_disjoint and comp_undersample05 are protocol choices already measured, cumulatively, by the E0 ladder (+0.026 and +0.014 of M): here they are replications, reported descriptively.
rationale.ctx_primary: ctx_core_ppi tests redundancy (removing almost all context at once hurts); ctx_no_drugctx is the only single block the pilot suggests matters (-0.028).
rationale.ctx_equivalence: The claim that the interactome, GO annotation, pathway membership and the inherited biochemistry are individually not needed is an equivalence claim, tested as such (TOST). Margin 0.02 MRR = about one seed-to-seed standard deviation of R-GCN in E1 (0.016).
rationale.direction: one-sided 'less': removing a piece of machinery or of context is expected to lower performance on Task A, where E1 found the context helps discrimination.
rationale.multiplicity: Holm within each family over its primaries only (3 and 2 tests).
